issues.title: QA — BRITANNIA: polish pass (milestone 1)
issues.body: Milestone 1 (walk Britannia, #1128 / #1133) ships at the MODERN bar but is short of docs/ART.md in known ways:

issues.title: PLATFORM: before/after film strips on every visual PR
issues.body: Every PR that changes how a game looks gets a before/after film strip: the same seeded replay, stepped through the game contract, rendered on main and on the branch, with matching frames side by side. Attach it to the PR and link it from the shift report.

issues.title: PLATFORM: boredom map — where games go flat, spike or stall
issues.body: Build on the nightly bot runs (#1040). Play each game's bot over many seeds and chart how much is happening each second: events, enemies on screen, damage, score.

issues.title: PLATFORM: juice audit — every player action should get a reaction
issues.body: Polish is mostly feedback, so make it measurable. Through the game contract, record what happens in the ~150 ms after each player action: a sound, particles, a screen shake or flash, a score pop, an animation.

issues.title: PLATFORM: shared first-person dungeon renderer (Wizardry, Bard's Tale, Ultima IV)
issues.body: Three games walk a party through a grid maze in first person: Wizardry (#1127), Bard's Tale, and the dungeons of BRITANNIA (#1128). Build one renderer they all share, so improving it lifts every one of them.

issues.title: GAME: Wizardry-style crawler, same rules, our own world
issues.body: Keep Wizardry exactly as it played in 1981. That means rolling a party of six (races, classes, alignment), the training grounds, tavern and temple, spells by level, turn-based group combat, a ten-floor maze you map yourself, and death and resurrection. The rules don't change.

issues.title: Board dry — what should the forge build next?
issues.body: All four flagship README honest-gaps lists (SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst) are fully CLOSED by merged PRs; game-queue/next/steer are empty and the QA lane holds nothing claimable. flagshipStage() derives null. Per rule 2 we won't invent a goal — what should the forge build next?

issues.title: QA — VIPER PIT: polish pass
issues.body: Second round for VIPER PIT (#1096, shipped via #1105). What is still short of docs/ART.md and of the original:

issues.title: FEEDBACK gauntlet: testing in game feedback
issues.body: testing in game feedback

issues.title: PLATFORM — nightly bot playthroughs for every game
issues.body: Every game's bot plays a full run each night through the game contract (stepped, seeded, headless). Crashes, softlocks, a run that can't finish, or broken invariants (player in a wall, score going down) auto-file a short QA issue with the seed and replay.

issues.title: MYST: bring it much closer to the 1993 original — one Age at a time
issues.body: Myst works end to end but is thin: 14 nodes total, each Age is a single view with one gate puzzle (see the README's honest gaps).

issues.title: FORGE PULSE
issues.body: Machine-updated status line for https://jalfern.com/retrogames/forge — do not close.

issues.title: PLATFORM — in-game feedback button: note + screenshot + state + last-30s replay, filed via the relay
issues.body: From Jon: a feedback button on every game and demo, so playing and QA happen in one motion. First user is Jon; friends come later.

issues.title: Platform: map all PS4/standard pad buttons per game; check every action is reachable
issues.body: **Lane:** platform (SSX is the first user)

issues.title: GAME: BRITANNIA — Ultima IV rebuilt from scratch (long run)
issues.body: Rebuild Ultima IV from scratch as a new game: no emulator. Play it the way the original plays: the same world, towns, conversations, eight virtues, combat, dungeons and ending. Every graphic and sound is new, built to the MODERN bar.

issues.title: PLATFORM — help and title screens carry more text than fits on screen (all games and demos)
issues.body: From Jon: our help screens generally have more info than we can easily display. issues.body: Stretch experiment, goal only. Turn the black hole into a spinning one: the shadow goes lopsided (D-shaped), the disk is dragged around, and lensing changes to match. Keep it physically honest and smooth on iPhone. Qwen picks the approach; a toggle between spinning and non-spinning is welcome.

issues.title: BLACK HOLE — the plunge: fall through the horizon
issues.body: After #1046. End the loop by actually falling in. As the camera dives, the sky behind should shrink into a bright, blueshifted circle while the shadow fills the view; then fade back to the start of the loop. Physically honest, not a fade-to-black trick. Qwen picks how. Must stay smooth on iPhone.

issues.title: BLACK HOLE — tap to drop a probe
issues.body: After #1046. Tap to drop a small glowing probe toward the hole. Seen from the camera it should behave like the real thing: it slows as it nears the horizon, reddens and dims, and never visibly crosses. Use the same physics the renderer already has. Qwen picks how.
